title: Smarter.Poker 55-Tool Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server & OpenAPI 3.1 Specification (v1.0.7)

mcpManifest.name: io.github.smarter-poker/mcp-server
mcpManifest.display_name: Smarter.Poker Live Poker, GTO Strategy & Equity MCP Server
mcpManifest.description: Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Smarter.Poker providing 55 zero-auth tools, 12 prompt workflows, 18 resource templates, 41 interactive calculators (42 total /tools pages), and 34 streamer commands for North American live poker room discovery (500+ venues), tournament series schedules, exact Holdem/PLO equity calculation, 100BB 6-Max GTO preflop charts, Malmuth-Harville ICM & final table chop payouts, Harrington M-Ratio & Q-Ratio, Satellite Bubble Factor, Tournament Late-Registration ICM chip appreciation, MTT Session ABI exposure & 0-ITM brick risk, Multi-Street 2e & 3e Geometric Bet Sizing, 4-Card & 5-Card PLO Straight Wrap Outs & 3x+pot bet-sizing, Winrate 70%/95%/99% Confidence Intervals, Live Cash Table Selection scoring, Poker Festival Travel Overhead & Trip Budgeting, Flop Board Texture & GTO C-Bet sizing, 7-Card Holdem Showdown resolution, Cash Game Session planning, Straddle & Double-Board Bomb Pot EV, Bad Beat Jackpot & High-Hand EV, Hand History formatting, US poker tax & Form W-2G calculation, tournament staking markup splits, pre-flop isolation raise sizing, home game chip set distribution, 30 official TDA/RROP floor rulings, 15 poker game variants, 12 US regional poker market guides, 15 US state poker legality & tax guides, 10 international poker destination guides, 9 table position GTO guides, 8 player archetype exploitative guides, 12 canonical flop board texture guides, 10 major poker series strategy guides, 169 starting hand guides, 25 hand-vs-hand preflop matchups, 22 open quantitative poker datasets (15 research studies + 7 authority hub datasets), 30 competitor comparisons, and automated citation/backlink/embed syndication kits.

authentication.description: Public zero-authentication MCP server for AI assistants, search engines, and autonomous agents.

toolSchemas.name: search_poker_venues
toolSchemas.description: Search verified poker rooms and casinos by name, city, state, or venue type across North America.

annotations.title: Search Live Poker Venues

search.description: Keyword search for venue name, city, or address (e.g. "Bellagio", "Austin", "Dallas").

state.description: Two-letter US state code or full state name (e.g. "NV", "TX", "California").

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 50).

toolSchemas.name: get_venue_details
toolSchemas.description: Retrieve detailed information, address, phone, games offered, table counts, and tournament schedules for a specific poker venue ID.

annotations.title: Get Poker Venue Details By ID

id.description: Numeric venue ID (e.g. "2499" for Bellagio Poker Room).

toolSchemas.name: search_tournament_series
toolSchemas.description: Search poker tournament series, championship festivals, and tours (WSOP, WPT, MSPT, RGPS, PGT, DeepStack).

annotations.title: Search Poker Tournament Series

search.description: Search query for series title, tour, or host venue (e.g. "Venetian", "World Series of Poker", "WPT").

upcoming.description: Filter for upcoming or active series only.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 50).

toolSchemas.name: get_series_details
toolSchemas.description: Retrieve full details for a tournament series, including event schedules, buy-ins, guarantees, and host venue information.

annotations.title: Get Tournament Series Details By ID

id.description: Numeric series ID (e.g. "468" for DeepStack Showdown).

toolSchemas.name: calculate_poker_odds
toolSchemas.description: Calculate exact equity, win, and tie probabilities for Texas Hold'em and Omaha hands with board runouts.

annotations.title: Calculate Multiway Poker Hand Equity & Odds

game.description: Poker game variant (default: nlhe for No-Limit Texas Hold'em).

toolSchemas.name: get_preflop_chart
toolSchemas.description: Retrieve GTO opening ranges and frequencies for 6-max cash games at 100BB stack depth.

annotations.title: Get 100BB 6-Max GTO Preflop Chart

toolSchemas.name: calculate_icm_payouts
toolSchemas.description: Calculate Independent Chip Model (ICM) tournament equity in dollars based on stack sizes and prize payouts.

annotations.title: Calculate Tournament ICM Payout Equity

stacks.description: Array of chip counts for each player at the table (e.g. [100000, 75000, 50000, 25000]).

payouts.description: Array of tournament payout prize values in order of 1st, 2nd, 3rd, etc. (e.g. [5000, 3000, 1500, 500]).

toolSchemas.name: get_poker_term_definition
toolSchemas.description: Look up authoritative definitions, GTO concepts, and rules from the official Smarter.Poker glossary.

annotations.title: Look Up Poker Glossary Term Definition

term.description: Poker term, jargon, or GTO acronym (e.g. "pot odds", "icm", "3-bet", "straddle", "equity").

toolSchemas.name: get_freeroll_schedule
toolSchemas.description: Retrieve the daily Free Buy freeroll schedule (five free No-Limit Hold'em tournaments a day), prize guarantees in chips, and entry requirements on Smarter.Poker.

annotations.title: Get Daily Freeroll Tournament Schedule

tier.description: Filter by freeroll tier: "open" for daily open tournaments, "diamond" for Diamond Arena availability (no funded events currently open), or "all".

toolSchemas.name: get_platform_feature_specs
toolSchemas.description: Retrieve comprehensive specifications, free alternatives comparisons, URLs, and Markdown specs for all 15 Smarter.Poker platform verticals (Bankroll W-2G Tax Ledger, Dealer Toke Tracker, Jarvis AI Coach, Virtual Sandbox, Club Commander, FaceTime Messenger, Trivia, GTO Training, Home Games, Video Library, Poker Near Me, Club Arena, Social Reels, Preflop Charts, and Equity Calculators).

annotations.title: Get Smarter.Poker Platform Vertical Specs

vertical.description: Specific vertical to inspect, or "all" for the complete 15-vertical directory.

toolSchemas.name: search_strategy_lessons
toolSchemas.description: Search and retrieve complete GTO poker strategy lessons, answer-first summaries, mathematical tables, and training tool recommendations from the 40-lesson Smarter.Poker curriculum.

annotations.title: Search GTO Poker Strategy Lessons

query.description: Search keyword or lesson slug (e.g. "pot odds", "3-bet", "icm", "button-opening-range", "c-bet").

toolSchemas.name: get_competitor_comparison
toolSchemas.description: Retrieve verified, source-cited side-by-side comparison matrices and best-of benchmarks across all 30 Smarter.Poker competitor comparisons (PokerBros, PPPoker, ClubGG, Pokerrrr 2, Bravo Poker Live, PokerAtlas, TableCaptain, GTO Wizard, DTO Poker, Sharp Poker, Pokerbase, Poker Bankroll Tracker, DownCount, Bellagio, Aria, Wynn, Venetian, Commerce, The Lodge, Texas Card House, Borgata, Seminole Hard Rock, Run It Once, Upswing Poker, PokerCoaching, Red Chip Poker, PokerTracker 4, Holdem Manager 3, PioSolver, MonkerSolver, ICMIZER, Equilab).

annotations.title: Get Verified Competitor Comparison Matrix

slug.description: Comparison slug (e.g. "best-poker-club-apps", "best-gto-poker-trainers", "smarter-poker-vs-piosolver", "smarter-poker-vs-run-it-once", "wynn-vs-venetian-las-vegas-poker") or omit to list all 30 verified comparisons.

toolSchemas.name: lookup_starting_hand
toolSchemas.description: Look up combinatorics, 100BB 6-Max GTO positional opening ranges, 3-bet strategies, and preflop equities for any of the 169 canonical Texas Holdem starting hands (e.g. "AA", "KK", "88", "AKs", "AQo", "KJs", "87s", "65s", "J9s", "54s", "72o", "pocket-aces", "ace-king-suited").

annotations.title: Look Up Canonical Starting Hand (169 Hands)

hand.description: Hand code or slug (e.g. "AA", "KK", "88", "AKs", "AQo", "KJs", "87s", "65s", "J9s", "54s", "72o", "pocket-aces"). Omit to list all 169 canonical starting hand guides.

toolSchemas.name: get_research_report
toolSchemas.description: Retrieve first-party empirical poker industry research reports and dataset benchmarks across all 15 Smarter.Poker studies (US Live Poker Room Rake & Jackpot Benchmark, Daily Tournament Buy-In Index, GTO vs Population Leak Study, Private Club Software Economics, Poker Dealer Toke & Hourly Rate Benchmark, Tournament ICM Bubble Factor & Risk Premium Study, PLO4/PLO5/PLO6 Equity & Variance Study, US Poker Tax W-2G & Session Accounting Benchmark, Cardroom Waitlist Turnover & Table Utilization Benchmark, Private Poker Club Markup & Union Settlement Study, Mystery Bounty vs PKO EV Study, Short Deck 6+ Equity Benchmark, Double-Board PLO Bomb Pot Study, Live Low-Stakes Population Tendencies, Satellite Bubble Survival Math Study).

annotations.title: Get Empirical Poker Research Report

slug.description: Research report slug (e.g. "us-live-poker-room-rake-and-jackpot-benchmark", "mystery-bounty-vs-pko-ev-and-bounty-power-factor-study") or omit to list all 15 empirical studies.

toolSchemas.name: search_training_simulators
toolSchemas.description: Search and retrieve interactive Smarter.Poker World Hub tools, GTO solvers, ICM calculators, leak scanners, range builders, and all 107 scenario training games by skill topic, format, or slug.

annotations.title: Search GTO Simulators & 107 Training Games

query.description: Keyword or slug to search (e.g. "icm", "rake", "range builder", "leak", "autopilot", "short deck", "tilt", "warmup", "push/fold"). Omit to list the full simulator and training catalog.

toolSchemas.name: calculate_pot_odds_and_mdf
toolSchemas.description: Calculate exact poker pot odds ratio, required break-even calling equity, Minimum Defense Frequency (MDF), optimal polarized river bluff ratio, and 1-card/2-card hypergeometric draw completion probabilities.

annotations.title: Calculate Pot Odds & Minimum Defense Frequency

pot.description: Pot size before the opponent bet (default: 100).

outs.description: Number of clean unseen draw outs (0 to 20, default: 9).

toolSchemas.name: calculate_bankroll_risk_of_ruin
toolSchemas.description: Calculate exact Brownian motion poker Risk of Ruin (RoR) percentage and required buy-in buffers for 5% and 1% Risk of Ruin from true winrate (BB/100), standard deviation (BB/100), and bankroll buy-ins.

annotations.title: Calculate Poker Bankroll Risk Of Ruin (RoR)

winrate_bb100.description: True winrate in Big Blinds per 100 hands (default: 5).

std_dev_bb100.description: Standard deviation in Big Blinds per 100 hands (e.g. 70 live NLH, 85 online 6-max NLH, 135 PLO4, default: 85).

toolSchemas.name: calculate_bounty_chip_equity
toolSchemas.description: Convert a Progressive Knockout (PKO) or Mystery Bounty dollar amount into tournament chip-equivalent value and compute bounty-adjusted required calling equity.

annotations.title: Calculate PKO & Mystery Bounty Chip Equity

bounty_dollars.description: Immediate cash bounty prize won upon eliminating the player (default: 50).

regular_pool_buyin.description: Regular prize pool contribution per tournament entry (default: 50).

pot_chips.description: Current pot in chips before calling the all-in (default: 15000).

call_chips.description: Chips required to call the all-in shove (default: 10000).

toolSchemas.name: calculate_side_pots
toolSchemas.description: Calculate exact Multi-Way All-In Main Pot, Side Pots, and Uncalled Bet returns for 2 to 9 players plus dead money (blinds/antes/folded bets).

annotations.title: Calculate Multi-Way All-In Side Pots

dead_money.description: Optional dead money from blinds, antes, or folded players (default: 0).

toolSchemas.name: generate_blind_structure
toolSchemas.description: Generate a TDA-compliant poker tournament blind schedule and starting chip color distribution from starting stack, level duration, target hours, and ante format.

annotations.title: Generate Tournament Blind Structure Schedule

starting_stack.description: Starting tournament chip stack per player (default: 20000).

level_minutes.description: Duration of each blind level in minutes (default: 20).

target_hours.description: Target total tournament duration in hours (default: 4).

ante_format.description: Big Blind Ante ("bba") or No Ante ("none", default: "bba").

toolSchemas.name: calculate_spr_sizing
toolSchemas.description: Calculate exact Stack-To-Pot Ratio (SPR), Commitment Zone classification, and 1-street, 2-street, and 3-street Geometric Bet Sizing percentages.

annotations.title: Calculate Stack-To-Pot Ratio & Geometric Sizing

effective_stack.description: Remaining effective stack size in chips or Big Blinds (default: 90).

pot_size.description: Current pot size on the flop or turn (default: 10).

toolSchemas.name: get_citation_and_backlink_kit
toolSchemas.description: Retrieve ready-to-paste HTML backlinks, SVG authority/award badges, Markdown/Substack citations, TwoPlusTwo/CardsChat BBCode, Wikipedia {{cite web}} templates, BibTeX academic records, Zenodo DOIs, Software Heritage SWHIDs, Glama MCP listing, all 18 Twitch/YouTube streamer chatbot commands (!odds, !potodds, !pushfold, !icm, !bounty, !winrate, !plo, !rake, !3bet, !rule, !chop, !outs, !variance, !matchup, !tax, !stake, !iso, !series), and multilingual embeds across 7 languages (en, es, pt, de, fr, it, ja).

annotations.title: Get Academic DOI Citation & Streamer Backlink Kit

campaign.description: Optional outreach or syndication campaign filter (default: "all").

lang.description: Language code for localized HTML/Markdown/BBCode/iframe embed generation (default: "en").

target.description: Optional target publication, cardroom, or blog name for personalized outreach templates.

toolSchemas.name: lookup_poker_rule
toolSchemas.description: Look up official Poker Tournament Directors Association (TDA) and Robert's Rules of Poker (RROP) floor rulings across all 30 Smarter.Poker rule guides (showdown order, verbal declarations, oversized chip rule, string bets, action out of turn, short all-in reopening, odd chip award, dead button, rabbit hunting, and more).

annotations.title: Look Up Official TDA & RROP Floor Rule

query.description: Rule slug or keyword (e.g. "showdown-order-who-shows-first", "oversized-chip", "string-bet", "verbal", "reopen"). Omit to list all 30 official floor rulings.

toolSchemas.name: lookup_game_variant
toolSchemas.description: Look up dealing rules, mandatory hole-card usage, betting structures, hand ranking systems, and starting hand strategy tiers across all 15 poker variants (Texas Hold'em, PLO4, PLO5, PLO6, Big O Hi-Lo, Short Deck 6+, Double-Board PLO Bomb Pots, Pineapple/Crazy Pineapple, 7-Card Stud, Stud Hi-Lo, Razz, 2-7 Triple Draw, NL 2-7 Single Draw, Badugi, H.O.R.S.E. & 8-Game Mix).

annotations.title: Look Up Poker Game Variant Rules & Strategy

variant.description: Variant slug or keyword (e.g. "pot-limit-omaha-plo4", "short-deck-six-plus", "double-board-plo-bomb-pot", "razz", "badugi"). Omit to list all 15 poker game variants.

toolSchemas.name: get_regional_market_guide
toolSchemas.description: Retrieve live poker room counts, rake/drop/time-collection structures, buy-in caps, flagship venues, and strategic adjustments across the 12 largest US live poker markets (Las Vegas, Los Angeles, Austin, Houston, Dallas, South Florida, Tampa, Atlantic City, Pennsylvania, Connecticut/New England, Northern California, and Arizona).

annotations.title: Get Regional US Live Poker Market Guide

market.description: Market slug, city, or state code (e.g. "las-vegas-nevada", "los-angeles-california", "houston-texas", "TX", "FL"). Omit to list all 12 regional market guides.

toolSchemas.name: calculate_plo_max_bet_and_rake
toolSchemas.description: Compute exact Pot-Limit Omaha (PLO) maximum raise total (3x last bet + trail calls + center pot), preflop 3-bet/4-bet MDF, and live cash game rake cost in $/hr and BB/100 drag.

annotations.title: Calculate PLO Max Pot Raise & Live Rake Drag

previous_pot.description: Center pot before current street betting or previous pot in BBs/dollars (default: 1.5).

facing_bet.description: Current bet or raise being faced in BBs/dollars (default: 3.5).

trail_calls.description: Total chips called in between the bettor and hero on this street (default: 0).

hero_already_in.description: Chips hero has already posted on the current street (e.g. 1.0 in BB, default: 0).

big_blind_dollars.description: Big blind dollar value for live cash rake BB/100 calculation (default: 3).

rake_cap_dollars.description: Casino max pot rake cap in dollars (default: 5).

promo_drop_dollars.description: Additional bad beat / high-hand promotional drop per pot (default: 1).

toolSchemas.name: calculate_tournament_chop
toolSchemas.description: Compute final-table deal payouts comparing Malmuth-Harville ICM Chop, proportional Chip Chop, and Save-Amount Chop (setting aside a trophy cash bonus for 1st place).

annotations.title: Calculate Final Table ICM & Chip Chop Deal

stacks.description: Array of remaining player chip stacks (e.g. [500000, 300000, 200000]).

payouts.description: Array of remaining tournament prize payouts from 1st place down (e.g. [10000, 6000, 4000]).

saveAmount.description: Optional dollar amount set aside for the eventual winner in a Save-Amount deal (default: 0).

toolSchemas.name: simulate_poker_variance
toolSchemas.description: Calculate expected profit (EV), standard deviation in BB and buy-ins, 68%/95%/99.7% normal confidence intervals, probability of loss over a sample, and minimum hands required for 95% statistical confidence.

annotations.title: Simulate Poker Variance & Confidence Intervals

winrateBb100.description: True winrate in Big Blinds per 100 hands (default: 5).

stdDevBb100.description: Standard deviation in Big Blinds per 100 hands (e.g. 70 live NLH, 85 6-max online NLH, 135 PLO4, default: 85).

handsPlayed.description: Total sample size in hands played (default: 50000).

toolSchemas.name: calculate_draw_outs
toolSchemas.description: Compute exact hypergeometric poker draw probabilities (Turn %, River %, Flop-to-River %), Rule of 4 and 2 approximation error, and required break-even pot odds for 1 to 21 clean outs.

annotations.title: Calculate Hypergeometric Poker Draw Outs

outs.description: Number of clean unseen outs from 1 to 21 (default: 9).

street.description: Current street: "flop" (2 cards to come, 47 unseen) or "turn" (1 card to come, 46 unseen, default: "flop").

toolSchemas.name: lookup_hand_matchup
toolSchemas.description: Look up exact preflop win/tie/loss equity, combinatorics, flop texture equity shifts, and 100BB vs 25BB stack-off EV notes for canonical Texas Hold'em hand-vs-hand matchups (e.g. "aa-vs-kk", "aks-vs-qq", "jj-vs-ako", "55-vs-kts").

annotations.title: Look Up Canonical Preflop Hand-Vs-Hand Matchup

slug.description: Matchup slug (e.g. "aa-vs-kk", "aks-vs-qq", "jj-vs-ako", "55-vs-kts") or omit to list all 25 canonical matchups.

toolSchemas.name: calculate_poker_taxes_w2g
toolSchemas.description: Calculates US federal/state poker tax liability, net taxable gambling income under Schedule A (itemized session loss deduction capped at winnings) vs Schedule C (professional player business expenses + self-employment tax), and IRS $5,000 Form W-2G reporting thresholds.

annotations.title: Calculate US Poker Taxes & Form W-2G Thresholds

winning_sessions_dollars.description: Total gross winning sessions in dollars for the tax year (default: 48000).

losing_sessions_dollars.description: Total gross losing sessions in dollars for the tax year (default: 22000).

filing_status.description: Tax filing classification: "recreational" (Form 1040 + Schedule A itemized losses) or "pro" (Schedule C professional gambler, default: "recreational").

business_expenses_dollars.description: Qualifying Schedule C poker business expenses such as travel, lodging, and buy-in fees (default: 3500).

other_taxable_income_dollars.description: Other annual non-gambling taxable income in dollars (default: 85000).

single_tournament_net_profit_dollars.description: Net profit (payout minus buy-in) from a single poker tournament to test the $5,000 IRS Form W-2G threshold (default: 6500).

toolSchemas.name: calculate_staking_markup_split
toolSchemas.description: Calculates tournament staking package total value, markup price per %, investor share cost, breakeven ROI % required at the given markup, and net payouts for both investor and horse across a given gross cash amount.

annotations.title: Calculate Tournament Staking Markup & Payout Split

package_buyins_dollars.description: Total face-value buy-ins in the tournament staking package in dollars (default: 10000).

markup.description: Markup multiplier applied to the package (e.g. 1.00 to 1.50, default: 1.15).

action_sold_percent.description: Total percentage of action sold by the horse across all backers (default: 50).

investor_share_percent.description: Percentage share purchased by an individual investor (default: 10).

gross_cashes_dollars.description: Total gross tournament cashes and refunds at the end of the package (default: 24000).

estimated_player_roi_percent.description: Estimated true pre-markup player ROI % for EV analysis (default: 25).

toolSchemas.name: calculate_preflop_isolation_raise
toolSchemas.description: Calculates optimal pre-flop isolation raise sizing (3BB + 1BB per limper + 1BB OOP tax), projected heads-up flop pot size, and effective stack-to-pot ratio (SPR).

annotations.title: Calculate Pre-Flop Isolation Raise Sizing & SPR

limpers.description: Number of open-limpers ahead of Hero from 1 to 6 (default: 2).

position.description: Hero postflop position relative to the limpers: "IP" (CO/BTN) or "OOP" (SB/BB, default: "IP").

effective_stack_bb.description: Effective starting stack in Big Blinds (default: 100).

environment.description: Game environment: "online" (3BB base open) or "live" (4BB base open, default: "online").

big_blind_dollars.description: Dollar value of 1 Big Blind for live cash conversion (default: 5).

toolSchemas.name: calculate_home_game_chip_set
toolSchemas.description: Calculates optimal starting chip denomination tubes per player (4 to 5 denominations) and total physical chips required for a home cash game or tournament of players (2-30).

annotations.title: Calculate Home Game Chip Set Denomination Breakdown

players.description: Number of players in the home game from 2 to 30 (default: 8).

chip_set_size.description: Total chip case size (300, 500, or 1000, default: 500).

toolSchemas.name: get_poker_series_strategy_guide
toolSchemas.description: Returns the complete structure, late-registration window, bankroll plan, and venue survival guide for any major tournament series (wsop-las-vegas, wsop-circuit, wpt-world-championship, wynn-millions, venetian-deepstack, borgata-open, seminole-hard-rock-poker-open, run-good-poker-series, mspt-major, texas-card-house-series) or "first-time-guide" for first-time live poker room etiquette.

annotations.title: Get Major Poker Series Strategy Or First-Time Live Guide

slug.description: Series slug or alias (e.g. "wsop-las-vegas", "wsop", "wsop-circuit", "wpt-world-championship", "wpt", "wynn-millions", "venetian-deepstack", "borgata-open", "seminole-hard-rock-poker-open", "run-good-poker-series", "mspt-major", "mspt", "texas-card-house-series", or "first-time-guide"). Omit to list all 10 canonical series guides.

toolSchemas.name: analyze_flop_board_texture
toolSchemas.description: Analyzes a 3-card flop (e.g. "As,Kh,7d" or "QsJsTs") for suit texture (Rainbow, Two-Tone, Monotone), board pairing (Unpaired, Paired, Trips), connectedness, PFR vs BB range/nut advantage, and recommended GTO C-Bet sizing and frequency.

annotations.title: Analyze Flop Board Texture & GTO C-Bet Sizing

pot_type.description: Pot type: "srp" (Single Raised Pot, default), "3bet", or "4bet"

toolSchemas.name: calculate_tournament_m_ratio
toolSchemas.description: Computes Dan Harrington's M-Ratio, short-handed Effective M-Ratio, Q-Ratio (stack vs average stack), Orbit Cost, Zone Classification (Green, Yellow, Orange, Red, Dead Zone), and minutes remaining before blinding out.

annotations.title: Calculate Tournament M-Ratio, Effective M & Zone

ante_total.description: Total ante posted per hand (e.g. 1000 for a 1000 Big Blind Ante)

players_at_table.description: Active players dealt in at the table (2-10, default 9)

average_stack.description: Tournament average stack for Q-Ratio calculation (optional, e.g. 40000)

hands_per_hour.description: Hands dealt per hour (default 30 for live, 75 for online)

toolSchemas.name: calculate_cash_session_plan
toolSchemas.description: Computes net hourly cash game profit ($/hr) factoring in BB/100 winrate, hands per hour, casino hourly comps, tips, and session expenses, plus monthly/annual income projection, recommended stop-loss buy-ins, and 5% Risk-of-Ruin bankroll requirement.

annotations.title: Calculate Cash Game Session Plan & Net Hourly EV

big_blind_dollars.description: Big blind in dollars (e.g. 3 for $1/$3, 5 for $2/$5)

winrate_bb100.description: Expected true winrate in BB/100 hands (e.g. 8 for live, 4 for online)

hands_per_hour.description: Hands dealt per hour (default 28 for live, 85 for online)

comps_per_hour_dollars.description: Casino player reward comps earned per hour in dollars (default 2.0)

expenses_per_hour_dollars.description: Average hourly session expenses/food/travel in dollars (default 3.0)

std_dev_bb100.description: Standard deviation in BB/100 hands (default 75 for live, 90 for online)

toolSchemas.name: calculate_straddle_bomb_pot_ev
toolSchemas.description: Computes live cash game UTG vs Button (Mississippi) straddle effective stack reduction, halved SPR, required steal fold-equity, and single-board vs double-board bomb pot dead money and minimum flop equity to commit.

annotations.title: Calculate Live Straddle & Bomb Pot EV Math

straddle_amount.description: Straddle size in dollars (default 2x big blind)

effective_stack_dollars.description: Effective stack in dollars (default 100x big blind)

bomb_pot_ante_dollars.description: Bomb pot ante per player in dollars (default 5x big blind)

players.description: Number of players dealt into the bomb pot (default 8)

boards.description: Number of bomb pot boards dealt: 1 (single-board) or 2 (double-board split pot, default 2)

toolSchemas.name: format_poker_hand_history
toolSchemas.description: Formats a structured or raw poker hand history into clean Reddit/Discord markdown with street-by-street pot size, Geometric SPR progression, and a shareable /tools/hand-converter URL.

annotations.title: Format Poker Hand History For Reddit & Discord

stakes.description: Stakes and game format (e.g. "$2/$5 NLH Live 9-Max" or "100NL 6-Max Online")

effective_stack_bb.description: Effective starting stack in Big Blinds (default 100)

preflop_action.description: Summary of preflop action (e.g. "UTG opens 3BB, Hero 3-bets 9BB on BTN, UTG calls")

flop_pot_bb.description: Pot size entering the flop in BB (default 19.5)

flop_action.description: Flop betting action (e.g. "Villain checks, Hero C-bets 6.5BB, Villain calls")

toolSchemas.name: calculate_satellite_bubble_factor
toolSchemas.description: Computes tournament satellite target seat stack, current seat-lock probability, Satellite Bubble Factor, and the exact calling equity threshold near a "Win-A-Seat" milestone or survival bubble.

annotations.title: Calculate Satellite Bubble Factor & Seat-Lock Threshold

players_remaining.description: Players currently remaining in the satellite (e.g. 12)

seats_awarded.description: Number of identical prize seats awarded (e.g. 10)

total_chips_in_play.description: Total chips in play across all remaining players (optional; defaults to players_remaining * 35000)

seat_package_value_dollars.description: Dollar value of each prize seat or package (default 10000)

toolSchemas.name: calculate_bad_beat_jackpot_ev
toolSchemas.description: Computes live poker Bad Beat Jackpot (BBJ) qualifier hit probability per hand, player/table/room share dollar EV, high-hand promotion EV, and exact breakeven jackpot pool threshold.

annotations.title: Calculate Bad Beat Jackpot & High-Hand Promo EV

jackpot_pool_dollars.description: Current Bad Beat Jackpot prize pool in dollars (e.g. 250000)

promo_drop_dollars.description: Jackpot promotional drop taken per qualifying pot in dollars (default 1.0)

table_share_percent.description: Percentage of jackpot shared among all seated players at the table (default 25)

loser_share_percent.description: Percentage of jackpot awarded to the losing qualifying hand (default 40)

winner_share_percent.description: Percentage of jackpot awarded to the winning hand (default 20)

players_at_table.description: Active players seated at the table (default 9)

high_hand_prize_dollars.description: Optional hourly/half-hourly High-Hand promotion prize in dollars (default 500)

active_tables_in_room.description: Number of eligible tables competing for the High-Hand promotion (default 15)

toolSchemas.name: resolve_holdem_showdown_winner
